agent_explanation: Controller fails to arrest cart drift: with initial x≈-0.31 and v≈-0.48 toward negative track end, pole angle small (-0.05 rad) and balanced, controller force stays <1 N (well below 41.4 N limit) insufficient to decelerate. Cart velocity remains negative and grows to ~-1.37 m/s, crossing x=-2.4 at step 264 despite pole remaining upright (margin 0.718 rad). Changing only initial velocity to 0 removes violation, confirming cause is controller gain/tuning inadequate for off-center initial momentum, not force saturation or external pushes.
